text:
ana_sales: Heads-up: prospect AcmeHealth asking for private VPC on-prem pricing + support tiers. Can we get a quick rate card and pointer to onboarding fees? POC likely 3 months. cc @mike_ae @jordan_ps

mike_ae: Thanks. Early numbers: platform license $120k/year (VPC) or $200k/year (on-prem air-gapped) + support. Enterprise support add-on (24x7 on-call) $60k/year. Committed spend discounts: 12mo commit 15% off, 24mo 25%, 36mo 33%. These are baseline — deal desk for anything >25%.

jordan_ps: POC asks we should confirm: data residency, KMS integration, SOC2 attestation, network egress limits. Also whether they require HSM-backed keys. @lee_se can we get a checklist and estimate for on-prem install effort (person-weeks)?

lee_se: Install effort ~2-3 engineer-weeks for standard VPC (remote install). For on-prem air-gapped with HSM it's 5-8 weeks and a one-time onboarding services fee $45k. We also offer a per-node licensing option for very small footprints: $12k/node/yr if <5 nodes. Otherwise flat license is cleaner.

ana_sales: Do we have packaging for 'Platform fee + Dedicated GPU pass-through'? Their infra team will own GPUs but want predictable license fees.

mike_ae: Yes — we can do 'platform fee + ops support' and list GPUs as pass-through. Sample line items below. I'll call out deal desk rules after the template.

mike_ae: ```
Platform license (on-prem VPC): $120,000/yr
Platform license (air-gapped on-prem): $200,000/yr
Enterprise Support (24x7): $60,000/yr
Onboarding services (one-time): $45,000
Per-node (if <5 nodes): $12,000/node/yr
Managed backups (optional): $10,000/yr
Per-GPU stewarding (ops): cost + 10% admin fee
Annual commit discount: 25% for 24mo
Special term: SLA uptime 99.9%
```

jordan_ps: Security notes: we can support customer-managed KMS and key rotation, logs remain inside customer's VPC. Need to confirm whether they want telemetry disabled entirely (possible for air-gapped builds). Also flag for export-control requirements.

dealbot: Deal desk flag: discount >25% or platform fee < $80k requires approval. Add 'deal_review' label and route to contracts@redwood.com.

legal_bot: FYI: If they request custom IP indemnity, escrow, or source-code access we'll need legal review; typical turnaround 5-8 business days.

ana_sales: Cool. Next steps: I'll draft initial SOW with 24mo commit at 25% off and request deal desk review. @mike_ae can you confirm we can fold onboarding fee into TCV to hit enterprise threshold? Also need a short security note for the customer to attach.

lee_se: I can draft the security note: SOC2 scope, KMS integration details, network isolation checklist, and telemetry opt-out. Will post the note and installer checklist in the next message.

ana_sales: :thumbsup: planning to schedule call w/ Acme infra lead Tues 10am PT. Will attach quote then.
